hypothesis: Selecting the Q7 quintet-scoring formula with the lowest mean exact quintet rank over the previous 100 scored targets improves the next target's normalized percentile rank versus uniform selection from the 1,023-formula grammar and versus a static Discovery-selected formula.
estimand: For each target t, choose formula mask argmin_m mean(rank[s,m]) over the preceding 100 scored targets s<t. Compare its zero-based exact quintet rank with the per-target mean rank across all 1,023 formula masks and with one static formula selected only on Discovery.

formula_universe.mask_mapping: rank_mask_MMMM maps directly to formula_id FMMMM; masks 1..1023
formula_universe.formula_features: All non-empty subsets of the 10 declared Q7 feature families; fixed equal-weight grammar.

policy.selection: minimum mean zero-based actual-quintet rank over previous 100 scored targets
policy.static_control: single formula selected by minimum mean rank on Discovery only; frozen for Validation and Blind OOS
policy.uniform_formula_control: per-target mean rank and Top-20/Top-100 fraction across all 1,023 formula IDs

walkforward.target_source: Q7 exact strict-prior rank ledger; current outcome is used only to score ranks already generated from prior draws
walkforward.target_update_order: Q7 runner scores target from prior state then adds target to state; selector reads only prior 100 rank rows

inference.primary: Blind OOS normalized percentile gain versus uniform selection over the Q7 formula IDs
secondary: Top-20 excess versus uniform formula expectation
Top-100 excess versus uniform formula expectation
normalized percentile gain versus the Discovery-frozen static formula
inference.correction: Holm-Bonferroni across all 11 registered aggregate tests

limitations: Q7 is a quintet-scoring grammar, distinct from per-number Q80/Q90 feature ASTs.
Historical Blind OOS is exposed prior research history, not virgin prospective evidence.
Holm correction covers only the 11 registered aggregate tests, not the full Q00-Q141 research family.
Q7 ends on 2026-10-24; later archive rows are excluded from this experiment.
